dataset_metadata.description: A large-scale multi-document summarization dataset consisting of news articles from the Newser website. Each instance pairs a professional, human-written summary with multiple source articles covering the same story, formatted with special tokens to delineate document boundaries.

schema_analysis.description: The concatenation of multiple source news articles related to a single event, where individual articles are separated by a special '|||||' delimiter.
A comprehensive human-written summary that synthesizes the information from all provided source documents.

structural_logic.relationships: The 'document' field serves as the source input (multi-document context) and the 'summary' field serves as the target output (ground truth).
structural_logic.label_dynamics: Not applicable (regression/generation task). The compression ratio is approximately 8:1.
structural_logic.potential_bottlenecks: Input documents often exceed the standard context window (e.g., 512 or 1024 tokens) of many transformer models; the use of the '|||||' separator requires specific preprocessing or custom tokenization handling.
